answer_1.quote: Experiments on PTB, Yelp, and Yahoo show that our method consistently improves the performance of various VAE models in terms of probability estimation and the richness of the latent space. The generalization to conditional modeling, i.e., Coupled-CVAE, largely improves the diversity of dialogue generation on the Switchboard dataset.
